tension: Indian consumers are seeking convenient, protein-rich snacks that fit into their busy lifestyles, while also prioritizing clean-label and permissible indulgence. This tension is driven by the growing awareness of health and wellness, particularly among the younger generation.
why_now: The recent partnerships between SuperYou and Starbucks, as well as the funding raised by SuperYou, indicate a growing demand for protein-rich snacks and a increasing competition in the market. The trend of prioritizing protein while choosing snacks is also on the rise, with 86% of Indians considering it a key factor.
